model.title: Model
model.description: The model name to use, e.g. gpt-4o or a provider-prefixed model your proxy routes.

input.title: Input
input.description: The user input / prompt to respond to.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Optional. System-level instructions that set how the assistant should behave.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Optional. Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Optional. 0 = focused and deterministic, higher = more creative. Leave blank for the model default.
